maintenance_led.reason: Sells beer, seltzer and other beverages, which are consumables used up; not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from distributors, retailers and consumers buying beer brands like Coors Light and Miller Lite, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own brewing brands like Coors Light and Miller Lite; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Beer and beverages are consumer products; retailers and drinkers can easily switch to competing brands.
